A [[human]]<ref name="Chapter 19" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Chapter 19 Subtitles" /> '''aristocrat''' was present at the [[Galaxies Opera House]] to complement [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]] after his speech. A [[Unidentified human aristocrat|fellow socialite]] present at the Opera House referred to this aristocrat as "darling."<ref name="Chapter 19" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The aristocrat appeared in "[[Chapter 19: The Convert]]," the nineteenth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Lee Isaac Chung]].<ref name="Chapter 19" /> [[Stephen Kearin]] portrayed the character.<ref name="Chapter 19" />
